name: Authentication Flow Testing
description: Exercise an authorized sign-in flow in the shared Browser session without inventing credentials or printing secrets.

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the sign-in screen in the shared Browser session.
See the auth UI state that actually rendered.
Type into a field only with a value the user supplied for this session.
Separate a page error from a rejected session.

validation.rule: The auth result cites the shared Browser session. No credential was invented, and no password or token was written into the reply.
